column5: Non-mandatory joint guidance from the Royal Statistical Society (RSS) and IFoA on the ethical and professional challenges of working in data science and AI. Structured around five recurring ethical themes: (1) seek to enhance the value of data science for society, (2) avoid harm, (3) apply and maintain professional competence, (4) seek to preserve or increase trustworthiness, (5) maintain accountability and oversight. Developed via four bottom-up workshops with data science professionals in 2018 covering workflow, organisational structure, executive/management awareness, and practitioners' responsibility to wider society. Includes an implementation checklist.
